boundary_evidence: The class's complete member set in one contiguous run: operator= at 0x0203821c, D1 at 0x02038224, C1 at 0x02038228 -- the entire ABI surface of a non-polymorphic one-word handle.

func_020381cc below walks the collider table through a pointer-to-pointer argument (the arm9/dBgPi manifest places it in this CLPS_BlockRef neighbourhood but it is a free helper, not a member); func_02038234 above is likewise unenrolled free code.
No vtable or RTTI emits here: CLPS_BlockRef has no virtuals, so there is no key-function machinery. The C2 and D2 variants the member definitions emit have no cartridge homes and deadstrip.

notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dBgPc entry, which took the same route.

CLPS_BlockRef is the one-word value handle dBgW_Kc carries (the header's comment: constructor, assignment and destructor shapes are ROM-proven at these addresses; the wrapper spelling is inferred). The TU defines all three members once and lets the compiler emit the ABI surface the way the original TU did.

Source order is constructor, destructor, then operator= so deferred codegen's reverse-source emission produces the ROM's operator=, D1, C1 layout; within each lifecycle group the compiler's own variant order lands D2 before D1 and C1 before C2, matching the cartridge.
